verses.original: Παῦλος ἀπόστολος οὐκ ἀπ’ ἀνθρώπων οὐδὲ δι’ ἀνθρώπου ἀλλὰ διὰ Ἰησοῦ Χριστοῦ καὶ Θεοῦ Πατρὸς τοῦ ἐγείραντος αὐτὸν ἐκ νεκρῶν
verses.transliteration: Paulos apostolos ouk ap’ anthrōpōn oude di’ anthrōpou alla dia Iēsou Christou kai Theou Patros tou egeirantos auton ek nekrōn
verses.literal: Paul an apostle [sent] not from men nor by man but by Jesus Christ and God [the] Father who raised Him from [the] dead

verses.original: καὶ πάντες οἱ ἀδελφοί σὺν ἐμοὶ Ταῖς ἐκκλησίαις τῆς Γαλατίας
verses.transliteration: kai pantes hoi adelphoi syn emoi Tais ekklēsiais tēs Galatias
verses.literal: and all the brothers with me To the churches - of Galatia

verses.original: Χάρις καὶ εἰρήνη ὑμῖν ἀπὸ Θεοῦ ἡμῶν Πατρὸς καὶ Κυρίου Ἰησοῦ Χριστοῦ
verses.transliteration: Charis kai eirēnē hymin apo Theou hēmōn Patros kai Kyriou Iēsou Christou
verses.literal: Grace and peace to you from God our Father and the Lord Jesus Christ

verses.original: τοῦ δόντος ἑαυτὸν ὑπὲρ ἡμῶν τῶν ἁμαρτιῶν ὅπως ἐξέληται ἡμᾶς ἐκ τοῦ ἐνεστῶτος τοῦ πονηροῦ αἰῶνος κατὰ τὸ θέλημα ἡμῶν τοῦ Θεοῦ καὶ Πατρὸς
verses.transliteration: tou dontos heauton hyper hēmōn tōn hamartiōn hopōs exelētai hēmas ek tou enestōtos tou ponērou aiōnos kata to thelēma hēmōn tou Theou kai Patros
verses.literal: who gave Himself for our - sins to rescue us from the present - evil age according to the will of our - God and Father

verses.original: ᾧ ἡ δόξα εἰς τοὺς αἰῶνας τῶν αἰώνων ἀμήν
verses.transliteration: hō hē doxa eis tous aiōnas tōn aiōnōn amēn
verses.literal: to whom [be] - glory vvv vvv forever [and] ever Amen

verses.original: Θαυμάζω ὅτι οὕτως ταχέως μετατίθεσθε ἀπὸ τοῦ καλέσαντος ὑμᾶς ἐν χάριτι Χριστοῦ εἰς ἕτερον εὐαγγέλιον
verses.transliteration: Thaumazō hoti houtōs tacheōs metatithesthe apo tou kalesantos hymas en chariti Christou eis heteron euangelion
verses.literal: I am amazed vvv how quickly you are deserting - the [One who] called you by [the] grace of Christ [and are turning] to a different gospel

verses.original: ὃ ἔστιν οὐκ ἄλλο εἰ μή τινές οἱ εἰσιν ταράσσοντες ὑμᾶς καὶ θέλοντες μεταστρέψαι τὸ εὐαγγέλιον τοῦ Χριστοῦ
verses.transliteration: ho estin ouk allo ei mē tines hoi eisin tarassontes hymas kai thelontes metastrepsai to euangelion tou Christou
verses.literal: which is not even [a gospel] Evidently . . . some [people] are troubling you and trying to distort the gospel - of Christ

verses.original: Ἀλλὰ καὶ ἐὰν ἡμεῖς ἢ ἄγγελος ἐξ οὐρανοῦ εὐαγγελίζηται ὑμῖν παρ’ ὃ εὐηγγελισάμεθα ὑμῖν ἔστω ἀνάθεμα
verses.transliteration: Alla kai ean hēmeis ē angelos ex ouranou euangelizētai hymin par’ ho euēngelisametha hymin estō anathema
verses.literal: But even if we or an angel from heaven should preach a gospel . . . contrary to the one we preached to you let him be under a curse

verses.original: ὡς προειρήκαμεν καὶ ἄρτι λέγω πάλιν εἴ τις εὐαγγελίζεται ὑμᾶς παρ’ ὃ παρελάβετε ἔστω ἀνάθεμα
verses.transliteration: hōs proeirēkamen kai arti legō palin ei tis euangelizetai hymas par’ ho parelabete estō anathema
verses.literal: As we have said before so now I say again If anyone is preaching to you a gospel . . . contrary to the one you received let him be under a curse

verses.original: Ἄρτι γὰρ πείθω ἀνθρώπους ἢ τὸν Θεόν ἢ ζητῶ ἀρέσκειν ἀνθρώποις εἰ ἤρεσκον ἔτι ἀνθρώποις ἂν οὐκ ἤμην δοῦλος Χριστοῦ
verses.transliteration: Arti gar peithō anthrōpous ē ton Theon ē zētō areskein anthrōpois ei ēreskon eti anthrōpois an ouk ēmēn doulos Christou
verses.literal: {Am I} now - seeking the approval of men or - of God Or am I striving to please men If I were still trying to please . . . men vvv vvv I would not be a servant of Christ

verses.original: γὰρ γνωρίζω ὑμῖν ἀδελφοί τὸ εὐαγγέλιον τὸ εὐαγγελισθὲν ὑπ’ ἐμοῦ ὅτι ἔστιν οὐκ κατὰ ἄνθρωπον
verses.transliteration: gar gnōrizō hymin adelphoi to euangelion to euangelisthen hyp’ emou hoti estin ouk kata anthrōpon
verses.literal: For I want you to know . . . brothers [that] the gospel - I preached . . . . . . - was not devised by man

verses.original: γὰρ ἐγὼ οὐδὲ παρέλαβον αὐτό παρὰ ἀνθρώπου οὔτε ἐδιδάχθην ἀλλὰ δι’ ἀποκαλύψεως Ἰησοῦ Χριστοῦ
verses.transliteration: gar egō oude parelabon auto para anthrōpou oute edidachthēn alla di’ apokalypseōs Iēsou Christou
verses.literal: - I did not receive it from any man nor was I taught [it] rather, [ I received it ] by revelation from Jesus Christ

verses.original: γὰρ Ἠκούσατε ἐμὴν ποτε τὴν ἀναστροφήν ἐν τῷ Ἰουδαϊσμῷ ὅτι καθ’ ὑπερβολὴν ἐδίωκον τὴν ἐκκλησίαν τοῦ Θεοῦ καὶ ἐπόρθουν αὐτήν
verses.transliteration: gar Ēkousate emēn pote tēn anastrophēn en tō Ioudaismō hoti kath’ hyperbolēn ediōkon tēn ekklēsian tou Theou kai eporthoun autēn
verses.literal: For you have heard of my former - way of life in - Judaism how severely . . . I persecuted the church - of God and tried to destroy it

verses.original: καὶ προέκοπτον ἐν τῷ Ἰουδαϊσμῷ ὑπὲρ πολλοὺς συνηλικιώτας ἐν μου τῷ γένει ὑπάρχων περισσοτέρως ζηλωτὴς τῶν παραδόσεων μου πατρικῶν
verses.transliteration: kai proekopton en tō Ioudaismō hyper pollous synēlikiōtas en mou tō genei hyparchōn perissoterōs zēlōtēs tōn paradoseōn mou patrikōn
verses.literal: - I was advancing in - Judaism beyond many of my contemporaries . . . . . . . . . . . . [and] was extremely zealous for the traditions of my fathers

verses.original: δὲ Ὅτε ὁ θεὸς ὁ ἀφορίσας με ἐκ μου μητρός κοιλίας καὶ καλέσας διὰ αὐτοῦ τῆς χάριτος εὐδόκησεν
verses.transliteration: de Hote ho theos ho aphorisas me ek mou mētros koilias kai kalesas dia autou tēs charitos eudokēsen
verses.literal: But when - God who set me apart . . . from my mother’s womb and called [me] by His - grace was pleased

verses.original: ἀποκαλύψαι αὐτοῦ τὸν Υἱὸν ἐν ἐμοὶ ἵνα εὐαγγελίζωμαι αὐτὸν ἐν τοῖς ἔθνεσιν προσανεθέμην οὐ εὐθέως σαρκὶ καὶ αἵματι
verses.transliteration: apokalypsai autou ton Huion en emoi hina euangelizōmai auton en tois ethnesin prosanethemēn ou eutheōs sarki kai haimati
verses.literal: to reveal His - Son in me so that I might preach Him among the Gentiles I did not rush to consult . . . . . . with flesh and blood

verses.original: οὐδὲ ἀνῆλθον εἰς Ἱεροσόλυμα πρὸς τοὺς ἀποστόλους πρὸ ἐμοῦ ἀλλὰ ἀπῆλθον εἰς Ἀραβίαν καὶ πάλιν ὑπέστρεψα εἰς Δαμασκόν
verses.transliteration: oude anēlthon eis Hierosolyma pros tous apostolous pro emou alla apēlthon eis Arabian kai palin hypestrepsa eis Damaskon
verses.literal: nor did I go up to Jerusalem to the apostles [who came] before me but I went into Arabia and [later] returned to Damascus

verses.original: Ἔπειτα μετὰ τρία ἔτη ἀνῆλθον εἰς Ἱεροσόλυμα ἱστορῆσαι Κηφᾶν καὶ ἐπέμεινα πρὸς αὐτὸν δεκαπέντε ἡμέρας
verses.transliteration: Epeita meta tria etē anēlthon eis Hierosolyma historēsai Kēphan kai epemeina pros auton dekapente hēmeras
verses.literal: Only after . . . three years did I go up to Jerusalem to confer with Cephas and I stayed with him fifteen days

verses.original: δὲ εἶδον οὐκ τῶν ἕτερον ἀποστόλων εἰ μὴ Ἰάκωβον τὸν τοῦ Κυρίου ἀδελφὸν
verses.transliteration: de eidon ouk tōn heteron apostolōn ei mē Iakōbon ton tou Kyriou adelphon
verses.literal: But I saw none of the other apostles except . . . James the - Lord’s brother

verses.original: ἰδοὺ ἐνώπιον τοῦ Θεοῦ ὅτι ἃ δὲ γράφω ὑμῖν οὐ ψεύδομαι
verses.transliteration: idou enōpion tou Theou hoti ha de graphō hymin ou pseudomai
verses.literal: I assure you before - God that what vvv I am writing to you vvv is no lie

verses.original: Ἔπειτα ἦλθον εἰς τὰ κλίματα τῆς Συρίας καὶ τῆς Κιλικίας
verses.transliteration: Epeita ēlthon eis ta klimata tēs Syrias kai tēs Kilikias
verses.literal: Later I went to the regions - of Syria and - Cilicia

verses.original: ἤμην προσώπῳ ἀγνοούμενος δὲ τῷ ταῖς ἐκκλησίαις τῆς Ἰουδαίας ταῖς ἐν Χριστῷ
verses.transliteration: ēmēn prosōpō agnooumenos de tō tais ekklēsiais tēs Ioudaias tais en Christō
verses.literal: I was personally unknown however - to the churches - of Judea that [are] in Christ

verses.original: δὲ ἦσαν μόνον ἀκούοντες ὅτι Ὁ ποτε διώκων ἡμᾶς νῦν εὐαγγελίζεται τὴν πίστιν ἥν ποτε ἐπόρθει
verses.transliteration: de ēsan monon akouontes hoti Ho pote diōkōn hēmas nyn euangelizetai tēn pistin hēn pote eporthei
verses.literal: - They only heard the account The [man who] formerly persecuted us {is} now preaching the faith - {he} once tried to destroy

verses.original: καὶ ἐδόξαζον τὸν Θεόν ἐν ἐμοὶ
verses.transliteration: kai edoxazon ton Theon en emoi
verses.literal: And they glorified - God because of me
